## Data Sources for Schertz Compensation Comparisons

Here's what I found regarding accessible data sources for comparing City of Schertz wages to private sector equivalents:  

### Highly Accessible & Free

#### BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS)

- May 2024 data is available for San Antonio-New Braunfels MSA (which includes Schertz)  

- Provides median and percentile wages (10th, 25th, 75th, 90th) by occupation  

- Downloadable in Excel format from: https://www.bls.gov/oes/tables.htm  

Key SOC codes for your comparisons:  

11-3121: Human Resources Managers  
11-3021: Computer and Information Systems Managers  
11-1021: General and Operations Managers (City Manager proxy)  
11-3031: Financial Managers  


- National data by ownership is available — BLS publishes separate wage estimates for private sector, state government, and local government at the national level  

***Limitation***: MSA-level data doesn't separate by sector or employer size  

\

#### Texas Municipal League (TML) Salary Survey

- Publicly accessible at https://salarysurvey.tml.org  

- Covers 27 common municipal positions including:  

City Manager/Administrator  
Human Resources Director  
Information Technology Manager  
Finance Director  
Police Chief, Fire Chief  
Public Works Director  

- Self-reported data from participating Texas cities  

- Searchable by city name or advanced search (population, region, etc.)  

***This is your best apples-to-apples source for municipal comparisons***  

\

#### BLS Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW)

- Has local government wage data by county and MSA  

- Breaks out by ownership (private, federal, state, local)  

- Less granular on occupation than OEWS  

- Partially Accessible (Summary Data Free, Details Require Subscription)  

\

#### Commercial Salary Databases

***Salary.com***: Shows national HR Director averages ~$158K-$172K; provides some size breakouts  

***PayScale***: Shows HR Director median ~$101K  

***Glassdoor***: Shows HR Director average ~$167K nationally  

***ZipRecruiter***: Shows HR Director 25th-75th percentile range of $88K-$137K  

\

These show significant variation by source, which illustrates the challenge. The $250K HR Director claim from your requester would be testable against these benchmarks.


### What the Data Can Tell Us

Based on my search:

Position BLS National Mean (May 2024) Private Sector Range  

- HR Managers (11-3121)~$145K-$167K.  (wide variation by size)  

- IT Managers (11-3021) Higher, ~$170K + Competitive market  

- General/Operations Mgrs~$120K-$140K (varies greatly)  


The requester's premise that "an HR Director should not be making $250,000 for a small city government" is testable. 

***BLS data shows a mean annual wage of $145,080 for Human Resources Managers nationally, with a median of $136,350. ***
